channels.name: Kwik Delivery
channels.description: Official channel of Kwik, an on-demand last-mile delivery platform operating in Lagos and Abuja (Mastercard and Total Nigeria partnerships, first African delivery platform with a WooCommerce plugin). Channel description explicitly aims to 'help you build and grow your eCommerce and logistics business', not just promote the service.
channels.focus: Building an ecommerce/logistics/dispatch business in Nigeria
channels.verificationMethod: Confirmed via the channel's own About section, which directly states its business-education purpose rather than pure service marketing. Cross-checked against Kwik's real operational history in Nigeria (Google Play listing, partnership press releases).

notes: Nigeria's dispatch/logistics content is dominated by two things: real, detailed articles on starting a bike delivery business (Kwik's own blog, TrustAm, MOC Accountants) and Jiji/job-board listings for hiring riders — but no dedicated Nigeria-specific business-of-dispatch YouTube channel beyond Kwik's official one emerged this round. Kwik's own blog (kwik.delivery/blog/) exists but reads mostly as corporate press releases rather than educational content, and no RSS feed was confirmed for it.
